reason: I'd install it and use the free 14 days, since no card is needed, but my son plays any app for about a week and then it gets deleted. By the time it asks me to pay, he'll be back on YouTube, which teaches letters for free.
objection: Why pay 25 thousand every month when YouTube and free apps already teach letters? And he'll lose interest anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If after the two free weeks he still asks for it by himself and I can see in the report that he really learned new letters, then I'd pay for one month.
